Forecast Discussion

High pressure moving off the southeast coast today leads to moist air moving back in the next several days.

Last weekend's front is to our south but creeps back toward us Wednesday. Then a new cold front from the northwest approaches Thursday, moves through Friday morning, and then exits slowly eastward.

We will have widely scattered showers and thunderstorms Wednesday afternoon. Coverage increases for Thursday afternoon and evening. Showers and thunderstorms continue into Friday (mostly in the afternoon) then taper off Friday evening.

High pressure moves from the Ohio Valley Saturday to the Southern Appalachians Sunday. We will still have the potential for isolated afternoon showers and thunderstorms Saturday and Sunday.

Temperatures begin to creep up with humid conditions early next week. Monday looks like the warmest day in a while.
